name: Zarrin
summary: Behind Dolanaar's inn, Zarrin teaches young night elves and visitors to cook with Teldrassil's native plants and animals. He tends an open hearth where they learn to prepare meals.

sections.title: Hearthkeeper of Dolanaar
sections.body: Behind Dolanaar's inn, Zarrin tends an open cooking fire and teaches Kaldorei cooking. Teldrassil's native plants and animals feed those who live here. Zarrin shows visitors how to forage and prepare meals at home.

faq.answer: Find Zarrin behind the inn in Dolanaar, at a cooking fire in the open yard across from the road.
Zarrin teaches beginners the basics of cooking and traditional night elf recipes.
Zarrin asks travelers to help prepare traditional dishes through Recipe of the Kaldorei, where newcomers learn local cooking practices.

angles.text: As you begin your journey in Teldrassil, Zarrin can teach you to prepare nourishing meals from wild beast meat and foraged goods.
As a night elf, you know Zarrin keeps Kaldorei foodways alive, passing on traditional tastes and methods beneath the World Tree's canopy.
